title: Arena Kiosk — Physical Devices, Templates & Deployment
overview: Two distinct things share the name 'kiosk' in this project: (1) the LIVE web templates served by Nova at /arena/kiosk/<id> that the real deployed devices load, and (2) a top-level 'Arena Kiosks' folder containing earlier standalone prototype HTML files. This chapter covers both plus the on-screen UX/UI details.

files.arena_kiosk.html: Kiosk picker/selection page (lists all configured kiosks)
files.arena_kiosk1.html: PC/Island room kiosk — full attract screen, choose (Visiting vs Play on a PC), PC picker floor map, sign-in form, success screen with wayfinding route
files.arena_kiosk2.html: Console room kiosk — simpler Visiting/Play flow, no PC picker (uses consoles/get-all from GGLeap, no State enum)

live_web_kiosk_templates.sync_requirement: arena_kiosk1.html and arena_kiosk2.html must be kept in sync for any shared feature (announcement bar, language toggle, boot sequence, admin panel) — historically several bugs came from editing only one file.

kiosk_ui_general.screen_lock_precheck: A script runs BEFORE page render (using localStorage/cookies) to detect an active lockout and avoid a flash of the sign-in form

states: attract (idle branding + live 'X of Y PCs Available' polling /api/arena/pcs ~12s + 'Touch anywhere to begin')
pcPicker (floor-map grid grouped by island, tap available seat + Continue)
success (PC: unlock-checkmark animation + arena floor map with YOU highlighted + wayfinding route line to your seat) / (Visiting: simple welcome)

floor_map_design.layout: 5 islands stacked top-down (portrait orientation), each a 3-col x 2-row seat grid (SEAT_ORDER=[3,2,1,4,5,6], rotated 90° CW from the original 2-col x 3-row layout)
floor_map_design.front_row: Kiosk (far-left) + Door, wide Stage trapezoid (center, purple, varsity-only, locked), Door + Admin Desk (far-right)
floor_map_design.side_walls: Thin vertical 'TV' rectangles on both left and right edges
floor_map_design.seat_states: available(green) / reserved(amber, lock icon SVG) / in-use(red ✕ overlay) / off(dim placeholder, not yet wired in GGLeap)
floor_map_design.responsive_sizing: --seat CSS var computed via clamp() using container-query units (cqw) so the whole map fits any screen with zero scrollbar
floor_map_design.wayfinding_route: SVG elbow path from the kiosk position, along the front aisle, then up the gap beside the selected island, into the seat's row — dashed gold line with a marching-ants animation + a start dot at the kiosk

kiosk1_pc_flow.hold_model: Kiosk-side in-memory hold (see chapter 09) — 10-15 min depending on config, no GGLeap booking involved. PC is unlocked immediately on check-in if pc_lock_enabled; auto re-locks if the guest never actually logs in before the hold expires (no-show).

kiosk2_console_flow.difference_from_kiosk1: No PC/seat picker — console availability isn't tracked per-seat the same way; uses GGLeap consoles/get-all (Users/Guests arrays, no State enum, must filter Deleted)

returning_guest_and_language_features_hi.returning_guest_lookup: A 'Welcome back, <name>' tap-to-fill chip (debounced email lookup) was built, then FULLY REMOVED on 2026-08-10 for privacy reasons (the lookup endpoint was public) — HTML/CSS/JS/i18n keys and the backend /api/arena/kiosk/guest-lookup route were all deleted. The underlying arena_db.find_recent_guest() + email_hash column were left in place (harmless, unused) in case it's revisited with proper auth.
returning_guest_and_language_features_hi.en_es_toggle: Still active — #langToggle chip (EN|ES), persisted in localStorage 'arena_lang', translates static labels/buttons/hints/success messages via an I18N dict + T(k) helper; server-provided text (rules, welcome message) stays English
returning_guest_and_language_features_hi.wayfinding_text_removed: A gold '➤ Head to the <room>' text line was added then removed per user feedback on 2026-08-10 (kept only the arrow icons); the PC floor-map route line (see above) is separate and was kept
returning_guest_and_language_features_hi.device_health_telemetry_removed: Battery/charging/network heartbeat reporting (navigator.getBattery(), &batt=&charging=&net= query params) was built then FULLY REMOVED on 2026-08-10 at user request ('delete them and remove the heartbeat like battery and shit'). Kept: basic online/offline + last_seen + locked/attempts tracking, which pre-dated the battery feature.

admin_panel_on_kiosk.access: Top-right admin button -> passcode modal (default 1234, configurable)
capabilities: Toggle bypass-hours (test the kiosk when arena is officially closed)
Clear failed sign-in attempts / lockout state
Release Kiosk (clears the fullscreen/beforeunload trap, shows a green 'released' overlay) / Re-Lock (re-runs the full boot sequence)

lockout_and_trap_mechanism.lockout: After 5 failed sign-in attempts the kiosk shows a lockout screen (localStorage + cookie backed so a refresh can't bypass it); optional passcode recovery
lockout_and_trap_mechanism.trap: engageTrap() arms a beforeunload navigation guard + requests fullscreen + wakeLock; a bottom trap-pill is shown only while the Admin panel is open; the trap can ONLY be released via the passcode-gated Admin Panel

standalone_legacy_kiosk_files.nature: Self-contained, single-file HTML+CSS+JS applications (~500 lines / ~24KB each) — an EARLIER, standalone prototype of the sign-in kiosk UI, NOT the currently-served Nova templates.
features: Sign-in form with soft on-screen keyboard (alpha + numeric)
Tactile key-press sound via Web Audio sine wave
standalone_legacy_kiosk_files.relationship_to_live_system: These files are NOT wired to the live Nova backend (no /api/arena/* calls) — they appear to be an early design reference kept for history/comparison. The ACTUAL deployed kiosks load Nova's /arena/kiosk/<id> route (arena_kiosk1.html / arena_kiosk2.html), which is the fully-featured, live-data-driven version documented above.
standalone_legacy_kiosk_files.caution: Do not confuse these with the live templates when making UI changes — always verify which file a request refers to before editing.

physical_device_notes.hardware_transition: Purdue switched the physical kiosk devices from iPads to laptops around 2026-08-22, which is why the iOS 'Guided Access' boot step was removed from the live boot sequence (see chapter 09) — laptops have real keyboards and don't support Guided Access.
physical_device_notes.on_screen_keyboard: Disabled for the same reason (2026-08-23) — inputs are no longer 'readonly', physical keyboard now types directly into the form.
physical_device_notes.recommended_deployment: Each physical kiosk device's browser should be pointed at Nova's /arena/kiosk/<id> URL in a locked-down/fullscreen kiosk-mode browser, not at the standalone legacy HTML files.
